questions.question: How long does shipping take?
questions.answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days, express shipping takes 1-2 business days. International shipping varies by location.

questions.question: Do you offer free shipping?
questions.answer: Yes, we offer free standard shipping on orders over $50. Express and international shipping have additional fees.

questions.question: Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?
questions.answer: Shipping addresses can be changed within 2 hours of order placement. Please contact our customer service team immediately.

questions.question: What if my package is damaged or lost?
questions.answer: If your package arrives damaged, please contact us within 48 hours with photos. For lost packages, we'll work with the carrier to locate it or provide a replacement.

questions.question: How long do I have to return an item?
questions.answer: You have 30 days from the date of delivery to initiate a return for most items.

questions.question: Do I need a receipt to return an item?
questions.answer: Yes, you'll need your order number or receipt to process a return. You can find this in your order confirmation email.

questions.question: Are there any restocking fees?
questions.answer: We don't charge restocking fees for returns, but customers are responsible for return shipping costs unless the item is defective.

questions.question: Can I exchange an item for a different product?
questions.answer: Exchanges are available for the same item in different sizes, colors, or styles. For different products, please return the original and place a new order.

questions.question: What if I received a damaged or defective item?
questions.answer: If you receive a damaged or defective item, please contact us immediately. We'll arrange for a replacement or full refund at no cost to you.

questions.question: How do I track my return?
questions.answer: Once you ship your return, you'll receive a tracking number. You can also check the status of your return in your account dashboard.

contact.title: Need Help with a Return?
contact.description: Our customer service team is here to assist you with any questions about returns or exchanges.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our products and services

questions.question: What is your return policy?
questions.answer: We offer a 30-day return policy on all items. Items must be in their original condition with tags attached. Please contact our customer service team to initiate a return.

questions.question: How long does shipping take?
questions.answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping is available for 1-2 business days at an additional cost. International shipping times vary by location.

questions.question: Do you offer international shipping?
questions.answer: Yes, we ship to select international destinations. Shipping costs and delivery times vary by country. Please check our shipping page for more details.

questions.question: How can I track my order?
questions.answer: You can track your order using the tracking number provided in your confirmation email. You can also view your order status in your account dashboard.

questions.question: What payment methods do you accept?
questions.answer: We accept major credit cards, PayPal, and cash on delivery for select locations. All payments are processed securely.

questions.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
questions.answer: Orders can be modified or cancelled within 2 hours of placement. Please contact our customer service team immediately if you need to make changes.

questions.question: Do you offer warranties on products?
questions.answer: Most products come with manufacturer warranties. Please check the product description for specific warranty information. We also offer our own satisfaction guarantee.

questions.question: How do I contact customer support?
questions.answer: You can reach our customer support team via email at support@example.com, phone at +1 (123) 456-7890, or through our contact form on the website.
